title: Oracle Essbase Filter
description: A security filter in Oracle Essbase that controls member-level data access for a database. Filters define read, write, none, or metadata-read access for specific member combinations, enabling fine-grained security beyond application and database-level roles.

name.description: Filter name used to reference this filter when assigning it to users or groups.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the filter controls.

rows.description: Filter row definitions specifying the access level for each member combination.

FilterRow.description: A single row in a security filter defining the access level for a specific member or member combination.

access.description: Access level granted for the specified member combination. READ allows data retrieval. WRITE allows data updates. NONE denies all access. METAREAD allows viewing member names but not data values.

member.description: Member specification or cross-dimensional member combination that this filter row applies to.

type.description: Media type of the linked resource.
